20-21 Jul 2026 - Onboarding, Orientation & Infrastructure Overview (IT)

Briefings & instructions received:
- Company introduction & HRMS setup: completed HR orientation and configured the company HRMS account for attendance and workflow.
- Attended initial briefing with the Company Director, IT Executive and Operations Manager.
- System architecture briefing: technical overview of Reino Creative Group's proprietary software platforms and systems.

Works observed:
- Deployment pipelines: watched the IT Executive manage and monitor live CI/CD deployments across company platforms.
- Server maintenance & patching: live troubleshooting, error logging and emergency hotfix patching on the official company website.
- Cloud infrastructure: IT Executive accessing the company VPS via SSH and managing production databases.

Reflection & technical application:
- Granted initial server access credentials with safety protocols explained around environment variables and secure access privileges.

22-25 Jul 2026 - Digitalised Kid's Dictionary Project: Architecture & UI/UX Development (IT)

Works carried out:
- Requirement gathering & brainstorming: assigned to build a digitalised Kid's Dictionary inspired by "Kamus Adik"; mapped core architecture and the user journey (Landing -> Avatar selection -> Topic selection -> Content access / paywall).
- Content page development: built the primary content page structure and layout for dictionary entries.
- Authentication & access control: developed the initial login interface with Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) for Standard Users vs Admins.
- Paywall integration logic: implemented checks that lock specific topics based on subscription/payment status.

Feedback & iterative improvements:
- Presented progress to the Operations Manager and received targeted feedback.
- Refactored UI layouts for a more engaging kids' experience and streamlined backend navigation logic.

Theoretical / technical linkage:
- Applied RBAC, state management for paywall routing, and responsive frontend UI/UX patterns.

26-27 Jul 2026 - Kid's Dictionary: Feature Development & UX Testing (IT)

Works carried out:
- Landing page redesign: fantasy-world / cloud-portal theme with updated mascot artwork.
- Redesigned the drag-and-drop learning component.
- Rebuilt the header with the Reino Education logo, branding and a sound toggle.
- Background audio system with mute/unmute; disabled on admin-only pages.
- Loading spinner shown while a topic's images are still downloading.
- Database foundation (MySQL): initial schema for real parent accounts, replacing hardcoded credentials.
- Persistent learning progress stored in the DB so it survives logout, refresh and device changes.
- "Dah Belajar" badge on topic cards at 100% completion.
- Entitlement-based access system: admins manually grant/revoke access to paid topics (interim before the payment gateway).
- Child profiles: parents create and name multiple child profiles; profile selection required at every login.
- Header personalisation: shows the current child profile's name.
- account.php: "Pakej Yang Dimiliki" updated to reflect free and granted-access topics.
- Admin image editor built into the admin panel for pre-upload editing.
- New content page for the "Opposite Words" topic.

Feedback & iterative improvements:
- Ran real user testing and gathered UX feedback for refinement.

Theoretical / technical linkage:
- Database normalisation and relational schema design (MySQL) to move from hardcoded to persistent data.
- Session/profile-state management for multiple child profiles per account.
- Asynchronous loading patterns (spinners) for smoother perceived performance.

28-30 Jul 2026 - Technical Research, Payment Gateway, Deployment & Photo Training (IT)

Works carried out:
- CSS keyframe animation research: how @keyframes can animate images/illustrations in the UI.
- Hough Circle Detection research: studied the Hough Circle Transform (OpenCV) as a potential computer-vision technique.
- Payment gateway research: evaluated the CHIP payment gateway as the intended replacement for the manual entitlement system.
- Deployment & troubleshooting: assisted with deployment prep; fixed a server caching issue using timestamp-based file versioning; helped troubleshoot a faulty PC.

Observed / learned:
- Passport photo service training: camera, editing software and equipment for customer passport photo orders.

Feedback & iterative improvements:
- Implemented website improvements based on Company Director feedback.

Theoretical / technical linkage:
- CSS @keyframes define intermediate steps between a start and end style.
- The Hough Circle Transform maps edge points into a parameter space to find circle centres and radii.
- Payment gateway flow: checkout initiation -> API call -> confirmation webhook -> entitlement update.
- Cache-busting: timestamp/version parameters force clients to fetch updated files after deployment.

31 Jul - 1 Aug 2026 - Cross-Departmental Exposure & Production Dept. Support (IT / Production)

Works carried out:
- Assisted the production department with banner printing and DTF (Direct-to-Film) printing.

Observed / learned:
- Learned about solvent printing.
- Observed the heat press process for transferring designs onto shirts.
- Observed the laser cutting process.

3-4 Aug 2026 - Server Access, Kamus Reino Live Testing & majliskahwin.com Handover (IT)

Works carried out:
- Server & database access: given access to another server and database to deploy a project.
- Source code review: went through the Reino Education website's source code.
- Kamus Reino live testing: tested reinoeducation.com/kamusreino, including reset-password and the admin user management page (admin_users.php).
- New project handover: assigned to take over majliskahwin.com.
- Competitor & design research: studied other digital wedding-card websites and Apple's website for design inspiration.
- Design proposal: proposed a new design and functionality set for majliskahwin.com.

Theoretical / technical linkage:
- Reviewing an existing codebase before changing it maps data flow and conventions first.
- Admin-managed password resets and user management are common RBAC-adjacent account-recovery features.

5 Aug 2026 - majliskahwin.com: Reviews, Order Tracking & Paywall Logic (IT)

Works carried out:
- Customer review system: review page with optional photo upload; admin accept/decline; accepted reviews show on the homepage. Public view at ulasan.php, admin moderation at admin/reviews.php.
- Order record page: /rekod updated with tracking numbers and tidied action buttons.
- Watermark paywall: unpaid digital cards are watermarked; watermark removed once payment is confirmed (previously accessible without paying).
- Conditional UI buttons: Copy Link / Copywriting / RSVP / Guestbook disabled while unpaid; Pay Now / Delete disabled once paid.
- Edit flow cleanup: removed the confusing payment option from the edit screen.

Observed / learned:
- Learned another printing setup for producing smaller banners.

6 Aug 2026 - majliskahwin.com: Review Workflow, Order Status Sync & CSRF Research (IT)

Works carried out:
- Review mechanism overhaul: customer must order and pay before reviewing (1 order = 1 review); name and partner's name auto-fill from the order; editing a review resets it to pending for admin re-review.
- Order completion estimate added on the /rekod order page.
- Database query optimisation for performance.
- Fulfilment method field (pickup vs postage) added to admin/order-view.php.
- Print-lock status: "Sudah Dicetak" locks editing of the physical product once printed.
- Card link auto-regeneration: the card hashtag/link now regenerates live when the couple's name changes instead of sticking to the old name.
- Order status sync: normalised inconsistent statuses to pending_payment / paid / abandoned, added status colours and auto filter/search.
- Admin notification badge for pending reviews.
- UI modernisation: replaced alert()/confirm() dialogs with toast notifications and modals.
- Fixed index.php showing outdated homepage images despite updated files on the server.

Theoretical / technical linkage:
- CSRF (Cross-Site Request Forgery): an attacker tricks a logged-in user's browser into sending an unwanted request, abusing the session cookie sent automatically.
- Standard mitigation: a per-session/per-form CSRF token validated server-side, paired with SameSite cookies.

7-8 Aug 2026 - Production Dept. Support: E-Commerce Materials & Customer Banner (Production)

Works carried out:
- Helped the production department produce e-commerce materials and a customer banner using the appropriate equipment.

10-11 Aug 2026 - majliskahwin.com: Performance Testing & Bug Fixes (IT)

Works carried out:
- Performance testing: tested majliskahwin.com's performance and identified a number of bugs.
- Bug fixes: fixed the issues found during testing.

Theoretical / technical linkage:
- Performance testing before the planned Laravel migration catches issues while they are still cheap to fix.
- Fixing issues as found also builds a running list of known trouble spots to re-check after the move to Laravel.

12 Aug 2026 - IT Department Meeting: Server Utilisation & Laravel Proposal (IT)

Works carried out:
- Department meeting on a spike in server utilisation.
- Contingency planning: discussed the need for a contingency plan and started the next SOP for handling such situations.
- Laravel proposal: proposed adopting the Laravel framework as part of the contingency/future system plan.

Theoretical / technical linkage:
- A utilisation spike needs both an immediate contingency response and a longer-term SOP to prevent recurrence.
- Framework migration proposals are easier to justify when tied to a concrete incident rather than proposed in the abstract.

13 Aug 2026 - Laravel Introduction Presentation & Inventory System Kick-Off (IT)

Works carried out:
- Gave an introduction presentation on Laravel to the IT department.
- Department decision: based on the briefing, IT decided to move forward with Laravel for future systems.
- New project: started building a new Inventory Management System using Laravel.

Theoretical / technical linkage:
- Laravel's MVC structure, Eloquent ORM and tooling ecosystem were the key points supporting the proposal.

Laravel overview (from the presentation deck):
- Artisan CLI commands (make:controller, migrate, test) replace slow manual steps; they run in development, not on the live site.
- MVC separates concerns: Model = data/DB logic, Controller = requests, View = display, so a fix in one layer doesn't risk the others.
- Migration needs server support for SSH, Composer and Node.js, and dependencies need periodic updates for security and compatibility.

14-15 Aug 2026 - Production & E-Commerce Dept. Support (Production)

Works carried out:
- Helped the production and e-commerce departments with customer requests: banners, DTF prints and business cards.

Observed / learned:
- Learned to use the Lotus eco solvent printer.

Theoretical / technical linkage:
- Cross-training on production gives a practical sense of the physical side of order fulfilment that systems like majliskahwin.com must track.
- Learning new equipment builds hands-on familiarity beyond the software side of the internship.

17 Aug 2026 - majliskahwin.com: New Feature Assignment & Security Improvements (IT)

Works carried out:
- Feedback & new assignment: received feedback on majliskahwin.com and was assigned to build a new "Welcome Board" module (guestbook + photo gallery).
- Login rate limiting: added a rate limit on failed login attempts within a short time window.
- Refund mechanism: added a refund mechanism, not fully automated since CHIP does not support it directly.

18-19 Aug 2026 - Welcome Board Module & Launch Preparation (IT)

Works carried out:
- Welcome Board module: built the feature (Physical/Digital option) into the order flow, reachable via Login > Rekod Tempahan > More > Welcome Board; customers can print or save it (manual send-to-print at Reino not yet linked).
- Design cleanup & launch prep: tidied the design and began listing areas needing improvement before launch.
- Landing page updated, rendered with JPG images.
- Found a bug in the live preview feature (still in progress).

Theoretical / technical linkage:
- The Welcome Board's physical/digital split meant handling both a printable output and an in-browser live preview from the same underlying data.

20-21 Aug 2026 - Live Preview Fix, UI Cleanup & Sales Dept. Support (IT)

Works carried out:
- Fixed the live preview bug found the day before.
- Continued cleaning up the ordering page UI.
- Improved the Welcome Board UI/UX; its link is now hidden from public view unless the order is paid.
- Added an auto-generated QR location option for the physical card.
- Sales department support: helped handle sales and use their pipeline to keep operations running.

22 Aug 2026 - SEO Preparation for majliskahwin.com (IT)

Works carried out:
- SEO kickoff: started basic SEO work for majliskahwin.com.
- Performance improvements.
- Audited the mobile UI.
- Reviewed Google Search Console to prepare for SEO tracking.

24 Aug 2026 - SEO, Postage Pricing & Global Pricing Page (IT)

Works carried out:
- SEO: added Google Analytics tracking.
- Postage pricing: updated the postage price calculation to be weight-based.
- Pricing page: built a page to set item prices globally.

25-26 Aug 2026 - Mobile UI Fixes, Module Renaming & Order Tracking (IT)

Works carried out:
- Mobile UI fix and synced the header across all pages.
- Updated the customer email template.
- Added an opening animation with the MK logo to the Welcome Board.

28-29 Aug 2026 - Sales Department Support (Sales)

Works carried out:

Theoretical / technical linkage:

1 Sep 2026 - majliskahwin.com Soft Launch & Final Inspection Fixes (IT)

Works carried out:
- Soft-launched majliskahwin.com.
- Final inspection fixes: disabled right-click image saving on product pages; allowed switching the couple's name order; matched the "&" symbol font to the couple's name font; fixed mismatched guestbook wording between admin and customer views; added a custom material-spec field to pricing; adjusted homepage video contrast; fixed a background image upload bug in the guestbook; added an admin remarks page for product specs; added a 1x2ft direction-sign option to the live preview.
- Launch delay: official launch pushed to a new date after inspection.

2 Sep 2026 - New Features & Feedback for majliskahwin.com (IT)

Works carried out:
- Motion video ordering: added a motion video that plays before the digital card.
- Guestbook book feature (in progress): started letting customers pick a template to have their guestbook printed physically by Reino.
- Other fixes: made the live preview form sticky on wide screens; sorted guestbook/wish-card photos by event instead of one mixed list; fixed digital card textareas to respect line breaks; stopped background music overlapping the intro video; redesigned the expired-session (CSRF) page.
- Received more feedback on majliskahwin.com for further improvements.

Theoretical / technical linkage:
- The new guestbook book feature needs page count, price and weight locked in at order time, so photos uploaded later don't affect an already-paid order.
